scope: Delegated failed, needs_help and ambiguous task notices through existing private Telegram, private website/voice and household/native HA delivery. Document project failure delivery is not included.
activation: Durable installation-scoped watermark; terminal failures updated before or at activation are not automatically queued. Existing success delivery stays enabled.
checks: Zero active stored tasks before installation
Durable activation recorded through existing work scope
Installed conversation page includes non-success heading
deferred: Actual failure and channel delivery trials
limitations: Generic state-based notice with task title; full diagnostic details remain in task status.
Stopped work remains silent; stop confirmation uses existing control response.
Existing session expiry, origin, recipient and ambiguous-delivery rules still apply.
No guarantee of heard or seen delivery.
A failure notification is not a successful work result and does not restart the task.
